SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, round(sum(f.net_amount)) net
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id<900
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id <> 999
), refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id <> 999
), weekly AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, sum(amt) AS net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds) GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT t.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
       round(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year,
       round(l.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       round((t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly t JOIN weekly l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week

WITH x AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id NOT IN (999,125,129)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id NOT IN (999,125,129)
), w AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, sum(amt) v FROM x GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT t.fiscal_week, round(t.v,2) ty, round(l.v,2) ly, round((t.v/l.v-1)*100,1) g FROM w t JOIN w l ON l.fiscal_week=t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) sales_before_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
